functions.recoveredRole: Refresh the available-curve list after the Other Voltages filter changes
functions.behavior: Passes the Add Curve form and a false override value to the shared list-rebuild function. The rebuilt available-curves list then reflects OtherVCB.Checked for candidates whose display name starts with V_, together with the other category and text filters. The selected-curves list is unchanged.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds OtherVCB.OnClick to address 013cc670. The recovered handler contains only FUN_013cab80(param_1, 0). The form field table maps OtherVCB to offset +0x7b0. FUN_013cab80 requires a display-name prefix position of 1 for the embedded V_ constant before it reads that checkbox, then applies selected-object and text filters while it repopulates AvailableCurvesLB.
